items.html:
No correctness, security, or regression findings in either pinned diff.

  • Extension linking: Both packages require Maturin ≥1.12 and use PyO3 0.29. Removing extension-module matches PyO3’s supported migration: Maturin ≥1.9.4 sets PYO3_BUILD_EXTENSION_MODULE automatically, while ordinary Cargo tests retain Python linking. PyO3 documentation
  • Feature coverage and Clippy: Neither workspace retains a Cargo [features] section after this change, so removing --all-features loses no existing workspace feature coverage. Removing the explicit all = warn preserves default correctness errors; existing pedantic/nursery settings and CI’s -D warnings remain. Clippy documentation
  • Source builds and artifacts: The changed commands at treams .github/workflows/native-wheels.yml:299 and Advect’s corresponding line 187 use uv’s documented sdist-then-wheel behavior. Build isolation remains enabled. Checks and smoke installs consistently use dist/sdist; uploads still select only *.tar.gz, excluding the verification wheel. uv command contract
  • Hypothesis: treams tests/conftest.py:41–50 inherits active CI settings, overrides only the existing explicit settings plus health-check suppression, then derives ci and thorough from dev. CI derandomization and disabled database therefore remain intact. Hypothesis inheritance and built-in profiles

Reviewed committed changes only, with clean worktrees when inspected. Applicable guidance read; no REVIEW.md found. No tests, builds, or write-producing validation run. Platform linking, Pyodide, and runtime health-check behavior remain validation boundaries for the parent’s checks and remote CI.
